Alex: Quick ask — can someone run a microbench comparing int4 vs FP8 on the medium-seq (seq=1024) horizon for our smaller Llama-variant? Need p95 latency, tokens/sec, and QA-quality diffs (SQuAD+Commonsense subset). Target: <110ms p95 for hosted profile; if int4 gives >=20% throughput improvement and quality drop <=0.6% we can gate it.

Maria R: I can kick it off in dedicated infra later today. Which config? batch-size auto or fixed 8? kv-cache on? 

Alex: Use fixed batch 8 (to compare apples-to-apples) and KV cache enabled. Please run with quantized kernels + fallback to fp16. Also capture logits for the QA set. Command I'm using:
```
./bench/run.sh --model r-infer-3b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --quant int4,fp8 --kv-cache on --capture logits --out /tmp/quant-run
```

Maria R: Starting now on gpubox-12. I'll post artifacts. Initial smoke shows int4 p95 ~ 85ms, fp8 ~ 72ms, but QA EM drop seems ~1.2% on CommonsenseQA. Uploading logs in 5.

bench-bot: Upload complete: /artifacts/1887654321/quant-run.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

Joel: Can you also run with BS=4 and BS=16 to see scaling curve? Sometimes the throughput delta flips depending on batch. Also please include perf counters (L2 miss, kernel time) — add `--perf` flag.

Maria R: Yep will do BS=4/8/16 and include perf. One note: int4 run had slightly higher decode tail latency (p99) — maybe batching/warp divergence. 

Sasha: For the quality diff: could you add eval with temperature 0 and greedy decoding? stochastic sampling can hide small deltas. Also try turning off continuous batching on the runtime to isolate kernel perf (`CONT_BATCH=0`).

Alex: Good call. Let's collect: (1) BS sweep, (2) perf counters, (3) KV cache on/off single-run for int4, (4) greedy decoding QA eval. If int4 still shows >=1% EM drop on Commonsense we should gate it from default route. If it's <0.6% and throughput>20% we'll consider rollout to canary. 

Maria R: On it. I'll post a short summary table when done. ETA ~3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Joel: Thx — ping me once artifacts are up, I'll run profiler on the kernels.

Alex: Thanks team. If anyone hits weird OOMs or diverging logits, DM me. :thumbsup:
